description: Ex-Japan Air Self-Defense Force F-104J transferred to Taiwan under the Alishan 9 programme of September 1986; the airframe was displayed for years wearing the WRONG number 4303; in 2016 retired servicemen and ROCAF staff re-read the data plate in the engine bay and the marking was corrected to 4506; recorded here with the true identity in tail_number and 4303 as a false number the airframe wore
ROCAF tactical number 3184; USAF construction serial 52-5844; repainted and re-signed in the 2022 park refurbishment
